# Plan (opus, strong)

## Goal

On a first visit, the Almanac's pool draws every card in the grid's first render. It no longer draws `POOL_FIRST_CARDS` (48) first and the rest in a background render. The cold open's "whole grid in the DOM" then drops under the 9be40af baseline. Clearing a search, the deck builder and every other grid keep #2301's staging, and every existing test, #2301's `PoolGrid.render.test.tsx` included, stays green unchanged. The PR gives baseline, main and after numbers from the script below and two unit tests that keep the fix in place. The scroll p95 target cannot be met by any cheap fix (Open questions), so that part goes to a person.

What the planner measured (this runner, headless Chromium 1280x720, production builds, cold open from `/`, median of 4–6 fresh browsers, ms):

| | baseline 9be40af (481) | main 0c15ac9 (709) | this plan (709) |
|---|---|---|---|
| open: first card | 381–388 | 332–336 | 326–344 |
| open: whole grid in the DOM | 381–388 | 428–448 | 326–344 |
| open: on-screen faces drawn (#2303) | 381–388 | 546–548 | 455–462 |
| open: settled, text fitted | 596–630 | 632–633 | 582–606 |
| clear search: whole grid | 154–166 | 36–61 | 38–70 |
| clear search: settled, text fitted | 154–166 | 176–188 | 171–220 (noisy; same code as main) |
| scroll: mean / p95 | 53–58 / 79–84 | 69–74 / 104–118 | unchanged (same code) |
| warm second open: first card | 294 | 84 | 139–150 |

Why it works: on a first visit the lazy route chunk (`routes/chunks.tsx`) makes React hold the route's first commit for its fallback throttle (about 300 ms) whatever it costs. 48 and 709 cards both commit at 330–340 ms, so staging only adds the background render (about 90 ms) after the hold. Any `useDeferredValue` initial value schedules that render, so the new mode passes none.

## Files to touch

| File | | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/PoolGrid.tsx` | change | `PoolGridBaseProps.wholeFirst?: boolean`; `PoolGrid` reads it; `useDeferredValue` gets no initial value when it is set; header paragraph (#2266) gets one more sentence |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/CardBrowser.tsx` | change | `CardBrowserProps.wholeFirst?: boolean`, passed to both `<PoolGrid>` branches |
| `apps/web/src/routes/almanac.tsx` | change | `<CardBrowser … wholeFirst>` with a comment |
| `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/PoolGrid.render.test.tsx` | change | new `describe("#2334 …")` at the end; nothing existing edited |
| `apps/web/src/routes/almanac.test.tsx` | change | `import { Profiler } from "react"`; one new `it("#2334 …")` |

Do not touch: `POOL_FIRST_CARDS`, the existing tests, `PoolFace`, `fit.ts`, `near.ts`, `filters.ts`, `deckbuilder.css` (tried: Risks), `DeckEditor.tsx`, `shop/TokenPicker.tsx`, any e2e spec, `crates/`, `spec/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. No ruling: no rule changes. R630, R654, R1383, R1956000 and R2098000 keep working, since every card and face is drawn as before (rule 7: only the bundled catalog is read).

## Steps

1. `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/PoolGrid.tsx`, type `PoolGridBaseProps`: after the `own?: OwnCopies;` member, add:
   ```ts
     /**
      * #2334: the first render draws the whole pool, not POOL_FIRST_CARDS of it (the Almanac's). A pool
      * that grows later still keeps what it drew until the background render has drawn the rest.
      */
     wholeFirst?: boolean;
   ```
2. Same file, `export default function PoolGrid`: change `const { ids, catalog, ribbon = NEW_RIBBON_SET, own } = props;` to `const { ids, catalog, ribbon = NEW_RIBBON_SET, own, wholeFirst = false } = props;`. Replace the line `const deferred = useDeferredValue(ids, ids.slice(0, POOL_FIRST_CARDS));` (keep the comment above it) with:
   ```ts
     // #2334: no initial value for `wholeFirst`, since any initial value schedules a background render.
     const deferred = useDeferredValue(ids, wholeFirst ? undefined : ids.slice(0, POOL_FIRST_CARDS));
   ```
   It must be `undefined`, not `ids`: with `ids` the mount renders twice, and the step-6 test fails with `[60, 60]`.
3. Same file, header comment: the last line of the `// #2266: the Almanac draws about 700 cards` paragraph is `// POOL_FIRST_CARDS at once.` Replace that one line with:
   ```
   // POOL_FIRST_CARDS at once, or the whole pool with `wholeFirst` (#2334): the Almanac's pool mounts with
   // its route, whose first render React holds behind the route chunk's loading panel on a first visit
   // whatever it costs, so a staged mount there only delayed the rest of the grid.
   ```
